_comment: CRED traffic is entirely collect requests and reward notices. The collect
requests are caught by the global rule; these add the rest.
A collect request is money being ASKED for, not moved. Approving one
produces its own bank debit SMS, and most are never approved.
A CRED wallet credit is a load, not income -- same treatment as a PayZapp
load, so a consumer should treat it as a transfer rather than spending.
